messages:
rachel: follow-up from the authz postmortem. two parallel workstreams: (A) token TTL unit normalization + validation, (B) audit-log gaps and secrets/rotate hygiene. want owners, short mitigations for prod, and a compliance-ready artifact flow. tagging people who said they'd help in the retro.

ben: thanks. quick mitigation idea: add a strict-auth-proxy mode that rejects tokens with suspicious TTLs (ttl==0 or ttl > 30d) at the edge until runtime fix lands. cheap, reversible. can be a feature-flagged override.

ike: i'll take the secrets/rotate side. if audit finds more than 2k affected tokens we should trigger an automated rotate job with a staggered grace window. otherwise target manual rotates per-owner. will write rotate tooling to accept CSVs from the audit.

rachel: plan sketch: 1) runtime TTL normalization + validation at the writer boundary (seconds-only, reject <10s or >30d) 2) edge proxy strict mode as temporary mitigation 3) audit script to export anomalies grouped by service owner 4) rotate playbook + compliance artifacts.

ben: opened draft PR for proxy toggle: https://github.com/redwood/proxy/pull/812  feature `STRICT_TTL_MODE`. includes a small middleware check: if ttl==0 or ttl>2592000 then reject with 401 and log audit event. canary config ready.

ike: audit script i'm testing (batched redis approach):
```
redis-cli --scan --pattern "auth:token:*" | xargs -n200 | while read batch; do for k in $batch; do t=$(redis-cli ttl "$k"); if [ "$t" -le 10 -o "$t" -gt 2592000 ]; then echo "$k,$t"; fi; done; done > token_anomalies.csv
```
I'll post optimized version and memory perf numbers in SEC-5209.

nora: i'll own runtime changes. will add writer-level normalization (seconds), validation guards, and an integration test that simulates cross-binary writes during migration. feature flag `AUTH_TTL_SAFE` to gate rollout. target PR by 2026-04-04.

ops-oncall: drafting a condensed rotate runbook: 1) run ike's audit to generate CSV, 2) group by service & count, 3) if total > 2000 -> automated rotate with 24h grace window, else manual per-owner rotates, 4) enable `STRICT_TTL_MODE` in canary 5) validate audit events post-rotate for every rotated token, 6) store proof artifacts (CSV + audit ids) in secure storage. prepping a 30m readiness call tomorrow 09:00 PT.

ike: initial audit results posted to SEC-5209: ~1.9k anomalies, concentrated in 2 services. preparing CSV and will hand off to service owners for targeted rotates.

ben: added a quick canary policy: enable `STRICT_TTL_MODE` for 5% traffic 30m, then 25% 1h, then ramp. alert if auth failure rate increases >0.5% above baseline.

nora: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/4015  includes TTL normalization + unit tests + `ci/ttl-unit` integration harness. linking SEC-5209.

ops-oncall: added runbook checklist to SEC-5209 and scheduled weekly 20m follow-ups for 6 weeks to track regressions. will invite owners.

ike: rotate tooling updated to accept CSVs and emit audit IDs for each rotated token. will push tooling and attach proof artifacts to the ticket.

compliance-bot: REMINDER: for SEC-5209 please attach CSV, rotate run output, and audit log IDs before closing the follow-up (automated).

rachel: owners & deadlines (short):
- NORA: runtime PR + tests (due: 2026-04-04)
- IKE: audit CSV + rotate tooling + proof artifacts (due: 2026-03-31)
- BEN: proxy toggle + canary config (due: 2026-03-30)
- OPS-ONCALL: runbook + prep call (prep call: 2026-03-26)

ben: note for ops & compliance  runbook includes a small curl snippet to flip the proxy flag in deployment: `kubectl set env deploy/proxy STRICT_TTL_MODE=true --namespace=prod` and example curl to check status: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://auth.redwood.ai/health` which will return 401 if TTL invalid.

ike: final ask  make sure service owners update their own paginated token-cleanup scripts to prefer rotate over revoke when possible to reduce customer disruption. adding a one-liner to the runbook.

rachel: i'll run a 7-day post-deploy review on 2026-04-12 to look for auth errors, latency regressions, and unexpected revokes. please update SEC-5209 as work progresses. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
